what.text: This page follows refugees from Afghanistan living in Tajikistan, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 8615 Afghan refugees in Tajikistan, 0.3% of all refugees from Afghanistan.
Pakistan and Iran host the most Afghan refugees, followed by Germany and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Afghanistan in every year from 1987 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Afghanistan from 2015 to 2025, and an interstate armed conflict between Afghanistan and Pakistan in 2024 and 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1992 at 3000 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 15354, at the end of 2000.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2000 to 2001, 2021 to 2022 and 2024 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Tajikistan.
These are year-end totals for Tajikistan only, reported to UNHCR.
